intended_object: The natural group homomorphism Aut(G) → Aut(G/N), φ ↦ (gN ↦ φ(g)N), for a characteristic subgroup N of G. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The definition sends φ to `QuotientGroup.congr N N φ h`, using the fact that φ(N) = N because N is characteristic. This is the automorphism of G/N given by gN ↦ φ(g)N. The proofs of `map_one'` and `map_mul'` show that the assignment is a group homomorphism. Since N is characteristic, every automorphism of G descends to G/N, so this is the right setting. Requiring only a normal subgroup would not work, because a general automorphism need not preserve N. Mathlib has `MulAut.characteristic : MulAut G →* MulAut H`, which restricts automorphisms to a characteristic subgroup H, but I found no Mathlib definition of the version for the quotient. The definition is correct, and it is stated for an arbitrary group, which is the natural generality.
